images.name: desktop-overview
images.prompt: Create a high fidelity product UI prototype image, a single desktop application window for Rillane v1, a cross-platform proxy client. Chinese interface, readable precise text. 1600x1000 landscape, flat front-on screenshot, no device perspective. Clean native utility aesthetic inspired by Clash Verge navigation, not copying logo or visual identity. Porcelain background #F7F8FA, white surfaces, thin gray dividers, deep ink typography, restrained teal #007F78 accent, small amber warning. Comfortable dense 14-16px information text, strong hierarchy. Left rail 200px labeled Rillane with simple abstract two-stream symbol. Sidebar labels 总览, 节点与订阅, 规则与区域, 网络与 DNS, 连接诊断, 开发者代理, 设置. Selected 总览. Top title 总览, right small badge 原型 · 示例数据. Main upper panel green status 已连接, button 断开连接, uptime 01:24:18, two separate switches 系统代理 and TUN both enabled. Prominent segmented 代理模式: 规则 (selected), 全局, 直连. Under it text 仅处理已接管流量. Two equal scenario rows 游戏 → JP Game 01 and 网页 → SG Web 02, simultaneously active, not mutually exclusive tabs. Four modest counters: 下载 8.4 MB/s, 上传 320 KB/s, 活跃连接 128, 今日业务流量 1.28 GB; small note 入口与出口不重复累计. Quiet network throughput sparkline. Bottom two panels: 当前策略 大陆直连 · 其余代理 with edit action, DNS fake-ip · 嗅探按需; 流媒体检测 Netflix 可用 · SG · 2分钟前, Disney+ 未检测, button 检测 (one-time active test, not guaranteed unlock). Show capabilities without marketing claims or maps. All data fictional, no real subscription URLs, no shell secrets. Elegant professional readable software mockup.
